test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

_______ the teacher entered the classroom, all the students stood up to greet him.
solution:
The correct answer is '**As soon as**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**As soon as**" is used to show that something happens immediately after another event.
 
• The sentence describes an action that occurs right after the teacher enters the classroom, so "**As soon as**" is appropriate.
 
• **Options 1, 3**, and **4** are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"**As soon** **as** the teacher entered the classroom, all the students stood up to greet him."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Whereas"** is incorrect because it is used to contrast two different situations and does not fit the context.
 
• **Option 3: "Rather"** is incorrect because it is used to indicate preference or contrast, which is not suitable here.
 
• **Option 4: "Yet"** is incorrect because it is used to indicate something that has not happened up until now, which does not fit the context.
